events.title: Big Demo Update: Every System Unlocked, Smoother Battles, Safer Saves
events.summary: Hello, cultivators! Thank you for all the feedback in the community over the past few days — we read every post. events.title: Demo Update: Performance and Gameplay Improvements
events.summary: Hello, cultivators! This Demo update includes the following improvements: Performance: Optimized game loading, interface responsiveness and combat processing, reducing repeated loading and calculations. Combat: Added status icons and active skill names, improved floating combat text and refined transitions between regular floors. Interface: Improved the inventory, equipment and forging screens, standardized number formatting and refined English text layout. Fixes: Resolved issues with equipment

events.title: Full-Game Screenshots: Fiercer Horde Combat, Very Different from the Demo!
events.summary: Greetings, cultivators! Here is a new look at gameplay from the full game currently in development! Take on hordes of enemies with a five-member party, and put your team builds and character progression into action. From class skill combinations to equipment, cultivation manuals and realm progression, the full game brings further changes and additions built around horde combat. events.title: Demo Update: Forge Improvements and Combat Power Display
events.summary: The latest Demo update is now live. Updated the forge interface, with clearer crafting, tempering and dismantling controls and information. Added character and party Combat Power displays to help compare character development and equipment choices. Fixed errors when switching certain crafting categories and missing interface textures. Please keep sharing bugs and any controls you find confusing or unnecessarily complicated. Thank you for playing!
